title: The Last River Bearer
subtitle: A Novel of Water, Ice and a Thousand Gates
blurb: The Clear River has stopped, and the only person who can move water is sixteen-year-old Wen Lan. She sets out to walk two thousand kilometers up the dying river to its source, through dry deltas, terraced plains, a cliff gorge hung with trackers' ropes, a dead salt sea, a floating lantern town and a glacier at the roof of the world. A charming guide, a clever surveyor, a ferrywoman who tells the truth and a lord who hoards the river stand between her and the answer, and her gift is quietly turning her to ice. Some rivers can only be saved by a thousand hands.
author: Yang
